items.headline: Trey Owens throws for 2 TDs and runs for 2, leading Arkansas State past Georgia State 38-32
items.description: — Trey Owens threw for two touchdowns and ran for two others, leading Arkansas State to a 38-32 victory over Georgia State on Saturday night in the Red Wolves' homecoming game.
